schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Communication (id INT IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, comm_action NVARCHAR(255), comm_channelid INT, payload NVARCHAR(MAX))
CREATE INDEX idx_combined ON Communication(comm_action, comm_channelid)
generation_sql: INSERT INTO Communication (comm_action, comm_channelid, payload) SELECT TOP {row_count} 'Action' + CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS NVARCHAR), ABS(CHECKSUM(NEWID()) % 100), REPLICATE('A', 100) FROM sys.all_objects a CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects b

tables.name: Communication
tables.purpose: Primary table to simulate the blocking and index contention.
tables.distribution_notes: Uniform distribution with random comm_channelid values.
